title: Record step read machine
statement: Let $Q$ and $T$ be types with decidable equality. A machine with four work tapes, alphabet consisting of record symbols over $Q$ and $T$, and state set $	ext{Option}(	ext{Option}(	ext{Bool}))$ starts in the state indicating halt. At every step it stays in place and enters the state obtained by decoding the scanned input symbol when it is a binary digit; a blank or any non-digit input gives the inner value none, and the resulting value is wrapped as a nonhalting state.
hypotheses_covered: State set of nested optional Booleans
